normalized_text: On July 16, 1969, Apollo 11 astronauts Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin and Michael Collins sat atop a Saturn V at Launch Complex 39A. The three-stage 363-foot rocket used 7.5 million pounds of thrust to propel them into space.
